reviews.review: Full disclosure: I'm friends with the guy who made this game, but I'll do my best to be objective.  I don't normally go for roguelikes, but I found the experience of this one to be pretty engaging for my puzzle-solving sensibilities.  In the runs I did before writing this review, I had some very enjoyable eureka moments when discovering synergies between different tools and tile types, and figuring out how to best utilize them was pretty fun.  The overall aesthetic of the game is pretty charming.  For criticisms, I expressed to the dev a small frustration or two with the catalog (the "glossary" of tile types, tools, and tags), but it was very minor stuff, as all the information you need is expressed there quite well.  All in all, I had a fun time, and it would have been a good purchase even if I wasn't supporting a friend.  It's got me extra interested in the game he's working on right now!
